about: The one correction made to the second look's runner while the look was being run (README.md, the note of 2026-10-12). scripts/lib/watching-second-look-paid.mjs and tables.mjs read this file. A run already recorded by `the_earlier_runner` counts as made with the same things for a run by `the_corrected_runner`, checksum for checksum, and for no other runner: with any other runner on either side, a run is refused as made with another runner, as before. A runner's checksum is what `--status` prints and what every record keeps (`given.the_runners_checkout.runner_sha256`): one checksum of the runner's six files. The correction changed one of them, scripts/lib/watching-second-look-paid.mjs; `the_runners_five_other_files` is one checksum of the rest, which is the same before and after. If this file is not there, or does not hold two whole checksums and a reason, there is no exception at all. It is written once, with the correction, and a test holds this checkout's runner to it.
why: the runner the first five runs of the opus block were made with, on 2026-10-11, was corrected on 2026-10-12 in what it does after a session is over (it had taken the harness's own empty folder in a session's project for grooph's), in when it refuses to start one (from a checkout that cannot say what it is made with), and in nothing it hands a session: given-to-a-session.json, which the earlier runner made, is what the corrected one is held to by a test
